limits.title: It describes the model, not the world.
limits.text: It shows how the model reached its output. On its own it does not show that the decision was fair, lawful or correct.

limits.title: It is not causation.
limits.text: It shows how the model's output responds to its inputs, not that changing an input in the real world would change the real outcome.

limits.title: It is not a fairness test.
limits.text: A protected characteristic can influence decisions through other inputs that correlate with it, without appearing in the list.

limits.title: It does not check the data.
limits.text: If an input is wrong, the explanation faithfully explains the wrong input.

limits.title: It does not see your policy.
limits.text: Rules applied outside the model, such as cut-offs, overlays and manual decisions, are not part of the explanation. The record states them only when you record them beside the decision, and then as you recorded them.

notice: This record states what Kaimei stored and computed. It can support a compliance process; it does not make a decision, a notice or a filing compliant, and it is not legal advice.
